segments.comment: A debug Priest level-teleports to D:3, reads a wished cursed scroll of punishment and creates a hostile dust vortex, which engulfs him (mhitu.c gulpmu() takes the ball and chain off the map). He saves while engulfed: save.c dosave0()'s done_object_cleanup() puts the free ball and chain on the floor under the vortex, so savelev() writes them with the level and save_bc() has nothing dangling to write.

The restored Priest is still engulfed, with the ball and chain on the floor (restore.c find_lev_obj() gives back uball and uchain). He level-teleports to D:5: goto_level()'s unplacebc() leaves them on the floor while he is swallowed, and savelev()'s saveobjchn() frees them with D:3 and clears uball and uchain, so he arrives unpunished and walks freely. Back on D:3, find_lev_obj() re-attaches them and goto_level()'s placebc() reports 'bc already placed?' through impossible(); farlook then shows him chained to the far-off ball. Before the fix the port kept him punished after the teleport and crashed in move_bc() on the first step.
